gloss: party member; member of a political party

definitions.gloss: party member; member of a political party
definitions.explanation: A person who is officially registered as a member of a political party.

examples.japanese: {党員|とういん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十年|にじゅうねん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧{党員|とういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He has been a party member for over twenty years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{党員|とういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投票権|とうひょうけん}→投票権：27950_touhyouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{与|あた}えられる→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: In the party leadership election, all party members are given the right to vote.

notes:
A compound of {党|とう} (party) and {員|いん} (member). In Japan, becoming a {党員|とういん} typically requires paying annual dues and registering with the party organization. Party members can participate in internal elections such as choosing the party leader (⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党員|とういん}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: party member registration
- {党員|とういん}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: party membership qualification
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{党員|とういん}: rank-and-file member
- {党員|とういん}⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: party member vote

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{党首|とうしゅ}→党首：17742_toushu⟧: party leader — the head of a political party
- ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: legislator; member of parliament — an elected representative, not just a party member
- ⟦{支持者|しじしゃ}→支持者：17852_shijisha⟧: supporter — someone who supports a party without necessarily being a registered member
